geometry_holdout: moving-obstacle mechanism and phase/gap variants are held out from pump source geometry
qualification_boundary: registry membership is not Q-I or Q-N evidence
split_rule: variant modulo 3 within each mechanism/resolution block

stage24.selection: incremental coarse variants 4..7 plus medium variants 0..3; cumulative stage8+stage24=24

stage48.selection: incremental medium variants 4..7 plus all fine variants; cumulative stage8+stage24+stage48=48

stage8.selection: coarse resolution, variants 0..3, four per mechanism
